name: SAVED
expansion: Smart, Affordable Value for Everyday Decisions
tagline: Spend less on the things that don't matter, so there's more for the things that do
description: SAVED is a practical guide to running a household for less: cooking and groceries, home energy, repairs, smarter shopping, budgeting basics and family life, written in plain English without gimmicks or get-rich-quick promises.
author: The SAVED editorial team

categories.name: Kitchen & Groceries
categories.description: Meal planning, pantry staples, batch cooking and food storage: eating well while spending less and wasting almost nothing.

categories.name: Home & Energy
categories.description: Heating, cooling, lighting, water and laundry: the everyday habits and small upgrades that bring household bills down.

categories.name: Repair & Reuse
categories.description: Basic tools, mending, simple plumbing and appliance care: fixing things yourself safely, and knowing when to call a professional.

categories.name: Smart Shopping
categories.description: Second-hand buying, sales seasons, warranties, subscriptions and scams: getting real value every time you pay for something.

categories.name: Budget Basics
categories.description: Budgets, sinking funds, emergency savings, paperwork and how interest works, explained clearly and without personal financial advice.

categories.name: Family & Leisure
categories.description: Children's activities, parties, pets, gifts, school costs and holidays: a full family life on a sensible budget.
